visual_elements.description: Diagram canvas: very large rounded rectangle, peach fill, no/subtle border, holding every diagram element.

Left input group: light-green rounded rectangle with dashed green border containing 4 stacked rows. Each row, left to right: small 4-cell embedding block (cells colored yellow #FFFF00 / pink #FF66CC [?] / white #FFFFFF / green #92D050) with red label X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄ (top-to-bottom; subscripts very small, possibly ordered X₄–X₁ to match outputs) [?] → red arrow → medium-green rectangle 'W_k^(1)' (black bold) → red arrow → striped yellow/gray block with red label K₄, K₃, K₂, K₁ (top-to-bottom). A thin dashed green curve links this group's bottom to the input-sentence strip.

Right input group (mirror of left): 4 rows of 4-cell embedding blocks labeled X₁–X₄ [?] (same cell colors as left group) → green 'W_v^(1)' boxes → striped blocks labeled V₄, V₃, V₂, V₁ (top-to-bottom); arrows point LEFTWARD (flow X → W_v → V → multiply nodes).

Dot Product box: tan/brown rectangle with header 'Dot Product' in dark maroon bold (wraps as 'Dot' / 'Product') at top; inside, four small dark-blue filled circles arranged on a diagonal from bottom-left to top-right, connected by thin red arrows — a stylized depiction of the four dot products q₂·K₁…q₂·K₄; red arrows enter from K₁–K₄ (left edge, 4 arrows) and from q₂ (bottom edge, 1 arrow).
Yellow pill (rounded rectangle) with blue bold text 'Similarity', sitting above the Dot Product box.
Tall yellow rectangle with vertical (rotated 90°) orange-red bold text 'Scaling by √d'; directly above it, a red stacked fraction 'K.q / √d'.
Tall light-purple rectangle with vertical (rotated 90°) dark bold text 'Soft max' (with space).
Yellow pill with blue bold text 'Probabilities' above the Softmax box.

Four red circled-X multiplication nodes (⊗) stacked vertically; each receives a red arrow from the Softmax box (left) and a red arrow from its V block (right), and emits a red arrow upward into the Σ box.
Summation box: light-blue rectangle with one large dark-blue bold 'Σ' centered; yellow pill with blue bold 'Weighted SUM' above it.
Thick green block arrow pointing up-right from just below the Σ box to the Y₂ output block.
Output block: small striped vector block labeled 'Y₂' (red) surrounded by a green dashed border — the final attention output for word X₂.

Input sentence strip: light-green dashed rounded rectangle containing four embedding blocks labeled X₁, X₂, X₃, X₄ (red labels, left to right); X₂'s cells are filled pink/magenta #FF66CC (highlighted). A thick red block-arrow points up-right at X₂ from below-left. From X₂ a red arrow goes up to a white box with red border containing red 'W_q^(1)', then up to a striped block labeled 'q₂' (red), then into the Dot Product box's bottom edge. Thin dashed connectors run from the strip's ends toward the left and right X groups.

Dimension annotation box: mint-green rounded rectangle containing, left to right: small striped block with dark-red #943634 label '1×d' [?] → short arrow → yellow square with black bold 'W' → '=' → striped block with dark-red #943634 label 'd×d' [?] (raw glyphs ≈ '1'd' and 'd*1'd'); below, blue text 'd: Embedding Length'.
Slide-number badge: yellow circle with dark outline and black bold '37'.

Connector system of thin red arrows with exact counts: left-to-right flow — 8 arrows inside the left group (4 rows × X→W_k→K) plus 4 arrows from K₁–K₄ into the Dot Product box; right-to-left flow — 8 arrows inside the right group (4 rows × X→W_v→V) plus 4 arrows from V₁–V₄ into the ⊗ nodes; upward flow — 4 arrows Softmax→⊗, 4 arrows ⊗→Σ, and 3 arrows on the q₂ path (X₂→W_q^(1)→q₂→Dot Product).

A black mouse-pointer cursor (video-capture artifact) floats over the subtitle line at ~x 70%, y 17%.
